description: This file defines the data models, constants, and methods related to licensing in the Mattermost server, including license validation, tier classification, and license properties.

classes.name: License
classes.description: Represents a software license with details such as expiration, features, customer info, and SKU.

classes.name: LicenseRecord
classes.description: Tracks individual license record entries with ID, creation timestamp, and raw data.

classes.name: LicenseLimits
classes.description: Defines various limits associated with a license, such as post history and notifications.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Contains customer information including ID, name, email, and company.

classes.name: TrialLicenseRequest
classes.description: Represents a request for a trial license with customer and server details.

classes.name: Features
classes.description: Encapsulates feature flags and options available in a license, such as LDAP, MFA, and integrations.

methods.name: IsMattermostEntry
methods.description: Checks if the license is a Mattermost entry SKU.

methods.name: IsExpired
methods.description: Determines if the license has expired.

methods.name: IsPastGracePeriod
methods.description: Checks if the license is past the grace period after expiration.

methods.name: IsWithinExpirationPeriod
methods.description: Checks if the license is within 58-60 days of expiration.

methods.name: DaysToExpiration
methods.description: Calculates days remaining until license expiration.

methods.name: IsStarted
methods.description: Checks if the license start date has passed.

methods.name: IsCloudPreview
methods.description: Determines if the license is a cloud preview license.

methods.name: IsCloud
methods.description: Checks if the license is a cloud license.

methods.name: IsTrialLicense
methods.description: Checks if the license is a trial license.

methods.name: IsSanctionedTrial
methods.description: Checks if the trial license duration is within sanctioned bounds.

methods.name: HasEnterpriseMarketplacePlugins
methods.description: Checks if the license includes enterprise marketplace plugins.

methods.name: HasRemoteClusterService
methods.description: Checks if the license includes remote cluster service.

methods.name: HasSharedChannels
methods.description: Checks if the license includes shared channels.

methods.name: NewTestLicense
methods.description: Creates a test license with specified features, expiring in 90 days.

methods.name: NewTestLicenseWithFalseDefaults
methods.description: Creates a test license with specified features set to false.

methods.name: NewTestLicenseSKU
methods.description: Creates a test license with a specific SKU and features.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates a LicenseRecord's ID, creation timestamp, and data bytes.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp for a LicenseRecord before saving.

methods.name: MinimumProfessionalLicense
methods.description: Checks if a license is at least a professional tier.

methods.name: MinimumEnterpriseLicense
methods.description: Checks if a license is at least an enterprise tier.

methods.name: MinimumEnterpriseAdvancedLicense
methods.description: Checks if a license is at least an enterprise advanced tier.
